config.sessionStateDir: Directory that contains Copilot CLI session-state folders. Empty = ~/.copilot/session-state.
view.name: SkillTrace
config.documentIncludeNotes: Include the 'How to read' notes and the glossary in document copies (Markdown / HTML) of a summary. Off by default, to keep pasted documents light to edit. The on-screen summary always shows them.
config.autoFollowLatest: Keep the newest session (Copilot / Kiro) in view and update live as records grow (follow-tail: viewing a past session is never interrupted; new sessions only join the history with a badge).
skilltrace.description: See which skill files GitHub Copilot or Amazon Kiro actually loaded. SkillTrace overlays Copilot / Kiro session records onto a skill's reference graph and shows, per file, how certain its arrival is, the measured usage, and how full the context window became. 100% local, no tracking — a measurement tool and learning aid for Agent Skills.
config.filterToCurrentWorkspace: Show only sessions related to the currently open workspace folders in the history. Sessions whose workspace cannot be determined from their records are hidden while this is on. Can also be toggled with the filter button in the history view title bar.
